entry.author: New Zealand Symphony Orchestra
entry.summary:
Watch the full performance of Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons: Spring (La primavera) here: https://youtu.be/fEoXt6_M8fQ

A short excerpt from Antonio Vivaldi’s Spring, performed by players of the New Zealand Symphony Orchestra, led by Vesa-Matti Leppänen and featuring Anna van der Zee as soloist. Recorded during a relaxed session capturing the light and vitality of this iconic work.

Soloist: Anna van der Zee
Led by: Vesa-Matti Leppänen
Performed by: Players of the New Zealand Symphony Orchestra

Vision Production: Latitude Creative
Audio Production: RNZ Concert
